decisions.reason: A multi-model devore line close to the core range carries visible investment in samples, stock and reorder continuity that customers rely on, so management would rather persist than write it off.

This transparent burnout line with several models represents committed sampling and warehouse investment, and any weak results since 2020 can still be blamed on the temporary pandemic disruption of retail.
This single burnout fabric overlaps with the broader burnout and devore lines and has less invested in it, but with no clear evidence of failure the firm keeps it for reorder continuity.
The velour-like upholstery fabric extends the established upholstery business and has an enduring market, so dropping it would expose the earlier decision without a clear reason.
Flame-retardant fabrics required certification investment and serve contract buyers with steady demand, which strongly favors keeping this product.
A satin polyester lining is a staple complement to the made-to-measure sewing offer, costs little to stock, and supports the firm's broad availability promise.
